notes: Prism 2.9.1: your notes stop going missing. A single note that was blank, or busy being written, could quietly stop every note body from reaching a computer — titles and folders kept arriving, the writing itself never did, and nothing said so. That is fixed. Signing in on a second machine no longer blanks your name, your about-me and your instructions. "Clean up transcripts" was switching itself off behind your back; it stays on now and actually runs, so transcripts get the correction pass and names from your calendar are spelled the way you spell them. Tasks: editing a task's words saves instead of erroring and snapping back, a task lifted from a note shows which note it came from and when, and deleting a note no longer takes a task you typed yourself with it. Long stretches of one person talking arrive as one paragraph instead of a dozen fragments. Dictation now transcribes while you hold the key, so your words land about as fast as you can let go — it stays off until you turn it on in Settings. Your audio is never stored. Free.
